source.text: ה֣וֹי שׁוֹדֵ֗ד וְאַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א שָׁד֔וּד וּבוֹגֵ֖ד וְלֹא־בָ֣גְדוּ ב֑וֹ כַּהֲתִֽמְךָ֤ שׁוֹדֵד֙ תּוּשַּׁ֔ד כַּנְּלֹתְךָ֥ לִבְגֹּ֖ד יִבְגְּדוּ־בָֽךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Woe, destroyer, and you not destroyed, and treacherous one, and not they dealt treacherously with him; when you finish destroying you will be destroyed; when you complete dealing treacherously they will deal treacherously with you.

en.L: Woe, destroyer, [you who are] not destroyed, \q and treacherous one, [with whom] they have not dealt treacherously! \q When you finish destroying, you will be destroyed; \q when you complete dealing treacherously, they will deal treacherously with you.
en.B: Woe to you, destroyer, never yet destroyed yourself, \q and you who deal falsely, though no one has dealt falsely with you! \q Once your destroying is done, you will be destroyed; \q once you finish your treachery, others will deal treacherously with you.
en.R: How terrible it will be for you, destroyer! You destroy others, but no one has destroyed you. \q You betray others, but no one has betrayed you. \q When you finish destroying, you will be destroyed. \q When you stop betraying, others will betray you.

es.L: ¡Ay, destructor, [tú que] no has sido destruido, \q y traidor, [con quien] no han obrado con traición! \q Cuando acabes de destruir, serás destruido; \q cuando termines de traicionar, te traicionarán a ti.
es.B: ¡Ay de ti, destructor, que nunca has sido destruido, \q y tú que actúas con traición, aunque nadie te ha traicionado! \q Cuando termines de destruir, serás destruido; \q cuando acabes tu traición, otros te traicionarán.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para ti, destructor! Destruyes a otros, pero nadie te ha destruido. \q Traicionas a otros, pero nadie te ha traicionado. \q Cuando termines de destruir, serás destruido. \q Cuando dejes de traicionar, otros te traicionarán.

fr.L: Malheur, dévastateur, [toi qui n’as] pas été dévasté, \q et traître, [envers qui] on n’a pas agi en traître ! \q Quand tu auras fini de dévaster, tu seras dévasté ; \q quand tu auras achevé de trahir, on te trahira.
fr.B: Malheur à toi, dévastateur, que personne n’a encore dévasté, \q toi qui trahis, alors que personne ne t’a trahi ! \q Une fois tes ravages terminés, tu seras ravagé ; \q une fois ta trahison achevée, d’autres te trahiront.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour toi, destructeur ! Tu détruis les autres, mais personne ne t’a détruit. \q Tu trahis les autres, mais personne ne t’a trahi. \q Quand tu auras fini de détruire, tu seras détruit. \q Quand tu arrêteras de trahir, d’autres te trahiront.

sw.L: Ole, mharibu, [wewe] usiyeharibiwa, \q na mdanganyifu, [ambaye] hawakukudanganya! \q Utakapomaliza kuharibu, utaharibiwa; \q utakapokamilisha udanganyifu, watakudanganya.
sw.B: Ole wako, mharibu, wewe ambaye hujawahi kuharibiwa, \q na wewe unayetenda kwa hila, ingawa hakuna aliyekutendea kwa hila! \q Utakapomaliza kuharibu, utaharibiwa; \q utakapomaliza usaliti wako, wengine watakusaliti.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwako, mharibu! Unawaangamiza wengine, lakini hakuna aliyekuangamiza. \q Unawasaliti wengine, lakini hakuna aliyekusaliti. \q Utakapomaliza kuangamiza, utaangamizwa. \q Utakapoacha kusaliti, wengine watakusaliti.

decisions.choice: the destroyer and the treacherous one: an unnamed enemy power, most likely Assyria
decisions.reason: The enemy is not named. Chapters 28-32 and 36-37 deal with the Assyrian threat to Jerusalem; Sennacherib took Hezekiah's payment and still sent his army against the city (2 Kings 18:13-17), which fits the charge of treachery. The same pair of words describes a destroyer in 21:2.

decisions.choice: when you finish ... you will be destroyed: the punishment will match the crime
decisions.reason: Each verb returns on the one who did it: the destroyer is destroyed and the betrayer is betrayed. The plural "they will deal treacherously" has no stated subject; it means others in general.

decisions.choice: others
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "others" for the unstated plural subject.

decisions.choice: "Ole wako" (B)
decisions.reason: The woe is spoken to one person, so Balanced uses the second person "Ole wako" in place of the usual "Ole wao".

source.text: יְהוָ֥ה חָנֵּ֖נוּ לְךָ֣ קִוִּ֑ינוּ הֱיֵ֤ה זְרֹעָם֙ לַבְּקָרִ֔ים אַף־יְשׁוּעָתֵ֖נוּ בְּעֵ֥ת צָרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: O Yahweh, be gracious to us; for you we have waited; be their arm in the mornings, also our salvation in a time of distress.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, be gracious to us; for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} we have waited. \q Be their arm every morning, \q also our salvation in [the] time of distress.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, show us grace; we have waited for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Be their strong arm morning by morning, \q and our salvation when trouble comes.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, be kind to us. We have been waiting for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to help us. \q Be the strength of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people every morning. \q Save us when we are in trouble.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ten piedad de nosotros; a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} hemos esperado. \q Sé su brazo cada mañana, \q también nuestra salvación en [el] tiempo de la angustia.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, muéstranos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gracia; {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hemos esperado. \q Sé su brazo fuerte mañana tras mañana, \q y nuestra salvación cuando llegue la angustia.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sé bondadoso con nosotros. Hemos estado esperando que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} nos ayudes. \q Sé la fuerza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo cada mañana. \q Sálvanos cuando estemos en apuros.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, fais-nous grâce ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que nous avons attendu. \q Sois leur bras chaque matin, \q et aussi notre salut au temps de la détresse.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, accorde-nous ta grâce ; nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons attendu. \q Sois leur bras puissant matin après matin, \q et notre salut quand vient la détresse.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sois bon pour nous. Nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}attendons pour que tu nous aides. \q Sois la force de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple chaque matin. \q Sauve-nous quand nous sommes dans la détresse.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utuonee neema; tumekungoja {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Uwe mkono wao kila asubuhi, \q pia wokovu wetu wakati wa dhiki.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utuonyeshe neema; tumekungoja {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Uwe mkono wao wenye nguvu asubuhi baada ya asubuhi, \q na wokovu wetu taabu inapokuja.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utuhurumie. Tumekuwa tukikungoja utusaidie. \q Uwe nguvu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kila asubuhi. \q Utuokoe tunapokuwa katika taabu.

decisions.choice: their arm: the Hebrew text says "their", though the prayer speaks of "us" and "our"
decisions.reason: The shift from "us" to "their" is abrupt, and some ancient translations have "our arm". The Hebrew may mean the people the speakers pray for, or the leaders or fighters among them. Either way the arm stands for strength and help (40:10; 51:9).

decisions.choice: in the mornings: every morning, day after day
decisions.reason: Morning was when help was looked for after a night of danger (17:14; 37:36; Psalm 46:6). The plural means each new morning.

decisions.choice: the strength of your people
decisions.reason: Readable explains the arm as strength and keeps the third person by naming the people as God's.

source.text: מִקּ֣וֹל הָמ֔וֹן נָדְד֖וּ עַמִּ֑ים מֵר֣וֹמְמֻתֶ֔ךָ נָפְצ֖וּ גּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: From the sound of tumult peoples fled; from your rising up nations were scattered.

en.L: At [the] sound of tumult peoples flee; \q at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rising up nations are scattered.
en.B: At the roar of the uproar the peoples run; \q when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rise up, the nations scatter.
en.R: When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thunder, whole nations run away. \q When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} stand up to fight, the nations scatter.

es.L: Ante [el] ruido del tumulto huyen los pueblos; \q ante {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} levantarte se dispersan las naciones.
es.B: Ante el estruendo del tumulto huyen los pueblos; \q cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} te levantas, las naciones se dispersan.
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} truenas, naciones enteras huyen. \q Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} te levantas para pelear, las naciones se dispersan.

fr.L: Au bruit du tumulte, les peuples fuient ; \q quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} te lèves, les nations se dispersent.
fr.B: Au grondement du vacarme, les peuples s’enfuient ; \q quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} te lèves, les nations se dispersent.
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais gronder le tonnerre, des nations entières s’enfuient. \q Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} te lèves pour combattre, les nations se dispersent.

sw.L: Kwa sauti ya ghasia mataifa hukimbia; \q kwa kuinuka {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} mataifa hutawanyika.
sw.B: Kwa mngurumo wa ghasia watu hukimbia; \q unapoinuka, mataifa hutawanyika.
sw.R: Unaponguruma kama radi, mataifa mazima hukimbia. \q Unaposimama kupigana, mataifa hutawanyika.

decisions.choice: the sound of tumult: the roar of God's coming, like thunder
alternatives: the noise of the attacking armies
decisions.reason: Read with "your rising up", the noise belongs to God acting against the nations, as his voice thunders against Assyria in 30:30-31.

decisions.choice: they flee ... they were scattered: past forms describing what is certain to happen
decisions.reason: The verbs are perfect, but the prayer looks ahead to God's help; the prophets often speak of what God will surely do as already done.

decisions.choice: When you thunder
decisions.reason: Readable names the sound as God's own, as decision m1 explains.

source.text: וְאֻסַּ֣ף שְׁלַלְכֶ֔ם אֹ֖סֶף הֶֽחָסִ֑יל כְּמַשַּׁ֥ק גֵּבִ֖ים שׁוֹקֵ֥ק בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And your plunder will be gathered, the gathering of the caterpillar; like the rushing of locusts rushing on it.

en.L: And your plunder will be gathered [as] the caterpillar gathers; \q like [the] rushing of locusts [people] rush upon it.
en.B: Your spoil is swept up as caterpillars strip a field; \q like a swarm of locusts people rush upon it.
en.R: Nations, everything you stole will be taken away. People will grab it like caterpillars eating up a field. \q They will rush at it like a swarm of locusts.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} botín será recogido [como] recoge la oruga; \q como se lanzan las langostas, [la gente] se lanza sobre él.
es.B: {{plural_you:Su|Vuestro}} botín es barrido como las orugas despojan un campo; \q como un enjambre de langostas, la gente se lanza sobre él.
es.R: Naciones, todo lo que {{plural_you:robaron les será quitado|robasteis os será quitado}}. La gente lo agarrará como las orugas que devoran un campo. \q Se lanzarán sobre ello como un enjambre de langostas.

fr.L: Et votre butin sera ramassé [comme] ramasse la chenille ; \q comme se précipitent les sauterelles, [on] se précipite sur lui.
fr.B: Votre butin est raflé comme les chenilles dévorent un champ ; \q comme un essaim de sauterelles, on se jette dessus.
fr.R: Nations, tout ce que vous avez volé vous sera enlevé. Les gens s’en empareront comme des chenilles qui dévorent un champ. \q Ils se jetteront dessus comme un essaim de sauterelles.

sw.L: Na mateka yenu yatakusanywa [kama] tunutu wanavyokusanya; \q kama nzige wanavyorukaruka [watu] watayarukia.
sw.B: Mateka yenu yanakusanywa kama viwavi wanavyolimaliza shamba; \q kama kundi la nzige watu wanayarukia.
sw.R: Enyi mataifa, kila kitu mlichoiba kitachukuliwa. Watu watakinyakua kama viwavi wanavyolila shamba lote. \q Watakivamia kama kundi la nzige.

decisions.choice: your plunder: the loot the enemy nations had taken, now taken from them
decisions.reason: "Your" is plural and speaks to the nations of verse 3. What they had seized is gathered up by others, as in 33:23.

decisions.choice: caterpillar ... locusts: insects that strip a land bare
decisions.reason: Locust swarms in their different stages could eat every green thing in a field (Joel 1:4). The picture is of plunder taken completely and fast.

decisions.choice: people
decisions.reason: The participle "rushing" has no stated subject; Literal brackets "people" and the other levels supply it.

decisions.choice: Nations, everything you stole
decisions.reason: Readable names whom the plural "your" addresses.

source.text: נִשְׂגָּ֣ב יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י שֹׁכֵ֖ן מָר֑וֹם מִלֵּ֣א צִיּ֔וֹן מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Exalted [is] Yahweh, for dwelling [on] high; he has filled Zion [with] justice and righteousness.

en.L: Exalted [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} dwells [on] high; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has filled Zion [with] justice and righteousness.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is exalted, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives on high; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will fill Zion with justice and righteousness.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is greater than all. He lives in heaven above. \q He will fill Zion with fairness and with what is right.

es.L: Exaltado [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habita [en lo] alto; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha llenado a Sion [de] derecho y justicia.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es exaltado, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive en las alturas; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} llenará a Sion de derecho y justicia.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es más grande que todos. Vive en el cielo, allá arriba. \q Llenará a Sion de rectitud y de lo que es justo.

fr.L: Élevé [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} demeure [dans] les hauteurs ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rempli Sion de droit et de justice.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est élevé, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} habite là-haut ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} remplira Sion de droit et de justice.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est plus grand que tout. Il habite dans le ciel, là-haut. \q Il remplira Sion d’équité et de ce qui est juste.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ametukuka], kwa maana anakaa juu; \q ameijaza Sayuni hukumu na haki.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametukuka, kwa maana anaishi juu; \q ataijaza Sayuni haki na uadilifu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu kuliko wote. Anaishi mbinguni juu. \q Ataijaza Sayuni haki na mambo yaliyo sawa.

decisions.choice: high place: the height of heaven where God reigns
decisions.reason: The word means height; with "dwelling" it points to God's throne above the earth (57:15; Psalm 113:5).

decisions.choice: he has filled: what God will surely do, spoken as done
decisions.reason: The perfect verb sits among promises about the future (verse 6); it states what God will certainly do for Zion.

decisions.choice: fairness and with what is right
decisions.reason: Readable spells out justice and righteousness in plain words.

source.text: וְהָיָה֙ אֱמוּנַ֣ת עִתֶּ֔יךָ חֹ֥סֶן יְשׁוּעֹ֖ת חָכְמַ֣ת וָדָ֑עַת יִרְאַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה הִ֥יא אוֹצָרֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he will be the steadiness of your times, a wealth of deliverances, wisdom and knowledge; the fear of Yahweh, it [is] his treasure.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be the stability of your times, \q a wealth of salvation, wisdom and knowledge; \q the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, it [is] his treasure.
en.B: He will be the firm foundation of your times, \q a rich store of salvation, of wisdom and knowledge; \q the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is his treasure.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will keep you safe all your life. \q He will give you a great supply of help, wisdom, and knowledge. \q Respecting {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be your greatest treasure.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} será la estabilidad de tus tiempos, \q riqueza de salvación, sabiduría y conocimiento; \q el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, ese [es] su tesoro.
es.B: Él será el cimiento firme de tus tiempos, \q un rico tesoro de salvación, de sabiduría y de conocimiento; \q el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es su tesoro.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te mantendrá a salvo toda tu vida. \q Te dará gran abundancia de ayuda, sabiduría y conocimiento. \q Respetar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} será tu mayor tesoro.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera la stabilité de tes temps, \q une abondance de salut, de sagesse et de connaissance ; \q la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, c’[est] son trésor.
fr.B: Il sera le fondement solide de tes jours, \q une riche réserve de salut, de sagesse et de connaissance ; \q la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est son trésor.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te gardera en sécurité toute ta vie. \q Il te donnera en abondance le secours, la sagesse et la connaissance. \q Respecter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera ton plus grand trésor.

sw.L: Naye atakuwa uthabiti wa nyakati zako, \q wingi wa wokovu, hekima na maarifa; \q kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hiyo [ndiyo] hazina yake.
sw.B: Yeye atakuwa msingi imara wa nyakati zako, \q akiba tele ya wokovu, ya hekima na maarifa; \q kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiyo hazina yake.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakulinda salama maisha yako yote. \q Atakupa wingi wa msaada, hekima na maarifa. \q Kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutakuwa hazina yako kuu kuliko zote.

decisions.choice: the steadiness of your times: the one who makes your days secure
decisions.reason: The word means firmness and faithfulness. God himself is the steady ground of Zion's life in every season. "Your" is singular and speaks to Zion or her people as one.

decisions.choice: his treasure: the treasure of the people of Zion, spoken of as one person
decisions.reason: The pronoun is singular and masculine. It most likely refers to the people addressed as "your", whose true wealth is the fear of the LORD. It may instead mean the treasure God values most.

decisions.choice: your greatest treasure
decisions.reason: Readable follows decision m2 and uses "your", as earlier in the verse, for the same people.

decisions.choice: The LORD
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject of "he will be" from verse 5.

decisions.choice: "kumcha BWANA"
decisions.reason: The fear of the LORD is "kumcha BWANA", as the Psalms note settles; Readable keeps it too, since "kumcha" already joins reverence and fear.

source.text: הֵ֚ן אֶרְאֶלָּ֔ם צָעֲק֖וּ חֻ֑צָה מַלְאֲכֵ֣י שָׁל֔וֹם מַ֖ר יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, their valiant ones have cried outside; messengers of peace weep bitterly.

en.L: Look, their valiant ones cry out outside; \q [the] messengers of peace weep bitterly.
en.B: Listen! Their brave warriors cry out in the streets; \q the envoys sent for peace weep bitter tears.
en.R: Listen! Brave soldiers are crying out in the streets. \q The men sent to ask for peace are crying bitterly.

es.L: He aquí, sus valientes claman afuera; \q [los] mensajeros de paz lloran amargamente.
es.B: ¡Escucha! Sus guerreros valientes gritan en las calles; \q los enviados a pedir la paz lloran lágrimas amargas.
es.R: ¡Escucha! Soldados valientes están gritando en las calles. \q Los hombres enviados a pedir la paz lloran con amargura.

fr.L: Voici, leurs vaillants crient au-dehors ; \q les messagers de paix pleurent amèrement.
fr.B: Écoutez ! Leurs guerriers courageux crient dans les rues ; \q les envoyés chargés de la paix pleurent amèrement.
fr.R: Écoutez ! Des soldats courageux crient dans les rues. \q Les hommes envoyés pour demander la paix pleurent amèrement.

sw.L: Tazama, mashujaa wao wanalia nje; \q wajumbe wa amani wanalia kwa uchungu.
sw.B: Sikilizeni! Askari wao hodari wanalia barabarani; \q wajumbe waliotumwa kutafuta amani wanalia machozi ya uchungu.
sw.R: Sikilizeni! Askari hodari wanalia barabarani. \q Watu waliotumwa kuomba amani wanalia kwa uchungu.

decisions.choice: their valiant ones: their heroes or warriors
decisions.reason: This rare word is uncertain. It may be linked to a word for heroes (2 Samuel 23:20), or read as "Ariel", the name for Jerusalem in 29:1-2 ("I will appear to them" is another proposal). The sense "heroes" fits the parallel line.

decisions.choice: messengers of peace: envoys sent to make terms with the enemy
decisions.reason: Hezekiah sent word to Sennacherib and paid him heavily to withdraw (2 Kings 18:14-16), yet the Assyrian army still came. Their weeping shows the treaty has failed (verse 8).

decisions.choice: Listen!
decisions.reason: The particle calls attention; what follows is heard, a cry, so Balanced and Readable say "Listen".

source.text: נָשַׁ֣מּוּ מְסִלּ֔וֹת שָׁבַ֖ת עֹבֵ֣ר אֹ֑רַח הֵפֵ֤ר בְּרִית֙ מָאַ֣ס עָרִ֔ים לֹ֥א חָשַׁ֖ב אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Highways have been made desolate; the passer-by on the road has ceased; he has broken covenant; he has rejected cities; he has not valued man.

en.L: [The] highways are desolate; [the] traveler on [the] road has ceased. \q He has broken [the] covenant; he has despised cities; he has not regarded humankind.
en.B: The highways lie empty; no traveler walks the road. \q He has broken the treaty and scorned the cities; he has no regard for human life.
en.R: The roads are empty. No one travels on them anymore. \q The enemy has broken his agreement. He hates the cities. He does not care about people at all.

es.L: [Las] calzadas están desiertas; ha cesado [el] caminante en [el] camino. \q Ha roto [el] pacto; ha despreciado las ciudades; no ha estimado al hombre.
es.B: Las calzadas están vacías; nadie anda por el camino. \q Ha roto el tratado y despreciado las ciudades; no tiene respeto por la vida humana.
es.R: Los caminos están vacíos. Ya nadie viaja por ellos. \q El enemigo ha roto su acuerdo. Desprecia las ciudades. No le importa nada la gente.

fr.L: Les routes sont désolées ; le passant sur le chemin a disparu. \q Il a rompu l’alliance ; il a méprisé les villes ; il n’a fait aucun cas de l’humain.
fr.B: Les grandes routes sont vides ; plus aucun voyageur ne passe sur le chemin. \q Il a rompu le traité et méprisé les villes ; il n’a aucun égard pour la vie humaine.
fr.R: Les routes sont vides. Personne n’y voyage plus. \q L’ennemi a rompu son accord. Il déteste les villes. Il ne se soucie pas du tout des gens.

sw.L: Njia kuu zimekuwa ukiwa; msafiri barabarani amekoma. \q Amelivunja agano; amedharau miji; hamjali mwanadamu.
sw.B: Njia kuu zimekuwa tupu; hakuna msafiri anayepita barabarani. \q Amelivunja mkataba na kuidharau miji; hajali uhai wa mwanadamu.
sw.R: Barabara ni tupu. Hakuna anayesafiri juu yake tena. \q Adui amevunja makubaliano yake. Anaichukia miji. Hawajali watu hata kidogo.

decisions.choice: cities: the Hebrew text has "cities"; the Great Isaiah Scroll has "witnesses"
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the two words differ by one similar letter. "Witnesses" would fit a broken covenant, since agreements were sealed before witnesses; "cities" fits the enemy's contempt for the towns he takes. The traditional Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: covenant: the treaty between Judah and the enemy
decisions.reason: The word here is a political agreement, not God's covenant; it is the destroyer of verse 1 who breaks it.

decisions.choice: The enemy
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject of "he has broken", the destroyer of verse 1.

source.text: אָבַ֤ל אֻמְלְלָה֙ אָ֔רֶץ הֶחְפִּ֥יר לְבָנ֖וֹן קָמַ֑ל הָיָ֤ה הַשָּׁרוֹן֙ כָּֽעֲרָבָ֔ה וְנֹעֵ֥ר בָּשָׁ֖ן וְכַרְמֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: The land has dried up, has languished; Lebanon has been ashamed, has withered; Sharon has become like the Arabah, and shaking off [are] Bashan and Carmel.

en.L: [The] land mourns [and] languishes; Lebanon is ashamed [and] withers; \q Sharon has become like the Arabah, and Bashan and Carmel shake off [their leaves].
en.B: The land dries up and wastes away; Lebanon is put to shame and withers. \q Sharon is like the desert plain, and Bashan and Carmel drop their leaves.
en.R: The land is drying up and dying. The forests of Lebanon are dried up. \q The rich fields of Sharon are like a desert. The trees of Bashan and Mount Carmel are losing their leaves.

es.L: [La] tierra se enluta [y] languidece; el Líbano se avergüenza [y] se marchita; \q Sarón se ha vuelto como el Arabá, y Basán y el Carmelo sacuden [sus hojas].
es.B: La tierra se seca y se consume; el Líbano está avergonzado y se marchita. \q Sarón es como la llanura desierta, y Basán y el Carmelo dejan caer sus hojas.
es.R: La tierra se está secando y muriendo. Los bosques del Líbano están secos. \q Los campos fértiles de Sarón son como un desierto. Los árboles de Basán y del monte Carmelo están perdiendo sus hojas.

fr.L: La terre est en deuil [et] languit ; le Liban est honteux [et] se flétrit ; \q le Saron est devenu comme l’Araba, et le Basan et le Carmel se dépouillent [de leurs feuilles].
fr.B: La terre se dessèche et dépérit ; le Liban est couvert de honte et se fane. \q Le Saron est comme la plaine du désert, et le Basan et le Carmel perdent leurs feuilles.
fr.R: La terre se dessèche et meurt. Les forêts du Liban sont desséchées. \q Les riches champs du Saron sont comme un désert. Les arbres du Basan et du mont Carmel perdent leurs feuilles.

sw.L: Nchi inaomboleza [na] kudhoofika; Lebanoni inaona aibu [na] kunyauka; \q Sharoni imekuwa kama Araba, na Bashani na Karmeli zinapukutisha [majani yao].
sw.B: Nchi inakauka na kudhoofika; Lebanoni imeaibishwa na kunyauka. \q Sharoni ni kama uwanda wa jangwa, na Bashani na Karmeli zinapukutisha majani yao.
sw.R: Nchi inakauka na kufa. Misitu ya Lebanoni imekauka. \q Mashamba yenye rutuba ya Sharoni ni kama jangwa. Miti ya Bashani na mlima Karmeli inapukutika majani.

decisions.choice: dried up: the land mourns and dries out
decisions.reason: The verb can mean "mourn" or "dry up"; both senses fit a land stripped by war and drought (24:4).

decisions.choice: Lebanon, Sharon, Bashan, Carmel: the most fertile places in the land
decisions.reason: Lebanon's forests, the plain of Sharon, the pastures and oaks of Bashan, and the slopes of Carmel stood for richness and growth (35:2). Even they now look like the Arabah, the dry rift valley.

decisions.choice: their leaves
decisions.reason: The verb means "shake off"; what is shaken off is understood: the trees' leaves.

source.text: עַתָּ֥ה אָק֖וּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה עַתָּה֙ אֵֽרוֹמָ֔ם עַתָּ֖ה אֶנָּשֵֽׂא׃

records.literal_gloss: Now I will arise, says Yahweh; now I will be exalted; now I will lift myself up.

en.L: Now I will arise, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q now I will exalt {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}; now I will lift {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} up.
en.B: Now I will rise up, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q now I will show {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} high and mighty; now I will lift {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} up.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says, Now I will get up and act. \q Now I will show how great I am. Now I will show {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power.

es.L: Ahora me levantaré, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q ahora seré exaltado; ahora seré ensalzado.
es.B: Ahora me levantaré, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q ahora me mostraré excelso y poderoso; ahora me alzaré.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice: Ahora me levantaré y actuaré. \q Ahora mostraré lo grande que soy. Ahora mostraré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder.

fr.L: Maintenant je me lèverai, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q maintenant je {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}élèverai ; maintenant je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dresserai.
fr.B: Maintenant je me lève, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q maintenant je vais {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} montrer grand et puissant ; maintenant je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dresse.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : Maintenant, je vais me lever et agir. \q Maintenant, je vais montrer combien je suis grand. Maintenant, je vais montrer {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance.

sw.L: Sasa nitainuka, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q sasa nitajitukuza; sasa nitajiinua.
sw.B: Sasa nitasimama, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q sasa nitajionyesha kuwa juu na mwenye nguvu; sasa nitajiinua.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema, Sasa nitainuka na kutenda. \q Sasa nitaonyesha jinsi nilivyo mkuu. Sasa nitaonyesha nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.

decisions.choice: now ... now ... now: the moment for God to act has come
decisions.reason: The threefold "now" answers the prayer of verse 2 and the ruin of verses 7-9. God rises as a warrior rises to battle (2:19, 21).

decisions.choice: I will exalt myself ... I will lift myself up: God takes the high place proud people claimed
decisions.reason: The same words describe the LORD in 6:1 and 52:13 and stand against the pride brought low in 2:12-17. Verse 5 has already said the LORD is exalted.

decisions.choice: The LORD says, Now ...
decisions.reason: Readable puts the speaker first so the reader knows at once who is speaking.

decisions.choice: seré exaltado; me alzaré
decisions.reason: The English deity_pronoun span on "myself" has no free pronoun in Spanish; the reflexive and passive verb forms carry the sense without one.

source.text: תַּהֲר֥וּ חֲשַׁ֖שׁ תֵּ֣לְדוּ קַ֑שׁ רוּחֲכֶ֕ם אֵ֖שׁ תֹּאכַלְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: You will conceive dry grass; you will give birth to stubble; your breath [is] a fire [that] will consume you.

en.L: You conceive dry grass, you give birth to stubble; \q your breath [is] a fire [that] will consume you.
en.B: You are pregnant with chaff, and you give birth to straw; \q your own breath is a fire that will burn you up.
en.R: Your plans are as useless as dry grass and straw. \q Your own angry breath will be a fire that burns you up.

es.L: {{plural_you:Concebirán|Concebiréis}} paja seca, {{plural_you:darán|daréis}} a luz rastrojo; \q {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} aliento [es] un fuego [que] {{plural_you:los|os}} consumirá.
es.B: {{plural_you:Están|Estáis}} preñados de paja y {{plural_you:dan|dais}} a luz rastrojo; \q {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} propio aliento es un fuego que {{plural_you:los|os}} devorará.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} planes son tan inútiles como la paja seca y el rastrojo. \q {{plural_you:Su|Vuestro}} propio aliento lleno de ira será un fuego que {{plural_you:los|os}} quemará.

fr.L: Vous concevez du foin, vous enfantez de la paille ; \q votre souffle [est] un feu [qui] vous dévorera.
fr.B: Vous êtes grosses de foin, et vous accouchez de paille ; \q votre propre souffle est un feu qui vous consumera.
fr.R: Vos projets sont aussi inutiles que de l’herbe sèche et de la paille. \q Votre propre souffle de colère sera un feu qui vous brûlera.

sw.L: Mnachukua mimba ya majani makavu, mnazaa mabua; \q pumzi yenu [ni] moto [utakaowateketeza] ninyi.
sw.B: Mna mimba ya makapi, na mnazaa majani makavu; \q pumzi yenu wenyewe ni moto utakaowateketeza.
sw.R: Mipango yenu haifai kitu, kama majani makavu na mabua. \q Pumzi yenu ya hasira itakuwa moto utakaowateketeza.

decisions.choice: conceive dry grass, give birth to stubble: plans that come to nothing
decisions.reason: "You" is plural and speaks to the enemy nations. Conceiving and bearing stand for making and carrying out plans (59:4; Psalm 7:15); what they bring forth is worthless and burns easily.

decisions.choice: your breath: the enemy's own fury and schemes
decisions.reason: Their own raging spirit becomes the fire that destroys them, so their ruin comes from themselves (compare 1:31). The word can also mean "spirit".

decisions.choice: Your plans are as useless as dry grass and straw
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of conceiving and giving birth.

source.text: וְהָי֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת שִׂ֑יד קוֹצִ֥ים כְּסוּחִ֖ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יִצַּֽתּוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And peoples will be burnings of lime; thorns cut down, with fire they will be kindled.

en.L: And [the] peoples will be burnings of lime, \q thorns cut down [that] are set ablaze with fire.
en.B: The peoples will be burned to lime, \q like thorns that are cut and set on fire.
en.R: The nations will be burned up until nothing is left but white ash. \q They will burn like thornbushes that are cut down and thrown into a fire.

es.L: Y [los] pueblos serán calcinaciones de cal, \q espinos cortados [que] se encienden en el fuego.
es.B: Los pueblos serán quemados hasta quedar en cal, \q como espinos cortados que se echan al fuego.
es.R: Las naciones arderán hasta que no quede más que ceniza blanca. \q Arderán como espinos que se cortan y se echan al fuego.

fr.L: Et les peuples seront des fours à chaux, \q des épines coupées [qu’]on embrase au feu.
fr.B: Les peuples seront calcinés comme la chaux, \q comme des épines coupées qu’on livre au feu.
fr.R: Les nations brûleront jusqu’à ce qu’il ne reste qu’une cendre blanche. \q Elles brûleront comme des buissons d’épines qu’on coupe et qu’on jette au feu.

sw.L: Na mataifa yatakuwa kuchomwa kwa chokaa, \q miiba iliyokatwa [inayowashwa] kwa moto.
sw.B: Mataifa yatachomwa mpaka yawe chokaa, \q kama miiba inayokatwa na kutiwa moto.
sw.R: Mataifa yatateketezwa mpaka kibaki kitu kimoja tu, majivu meupe. \q Yataungua kama vichaka vya miiba vilivyokatwa na kutupwa motoni.

decisions.choice: burnings of lime: fire so hot it turns stone or bone to powder
decisions.reason: Lime was made by burning limestone in a kiln until it crumbled to white powder. Burning bones to lime was a sign of complete destruction (Amos 2:1).

decisions.choice: until nothing is left but white ash
decisions.reason: Readable explains what burning to lime leaves behind.

source.text: שִׁמְע֥וּ רְחוֹקִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וּדְע֥וּ קְרוֹבִ֖ים גְּבֻרָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear, distant ones, what I have done, and know, near ones, my might.

en.L: Hear, [you who are] far away, what I have done; \q and know, [you who are] near, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} might.
en.B: You who are far away, hear what I have done; \q you who are near, acknowledge {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} strength.
en.R: Listen, you people who live far away. Hear what I have done. \q You people who live nearby, see how strong I am.

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}}, [los que están] lejos, lo que he hecho; \q y {{plural_you:conozcan|conoced}}, [los que están] cerca, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes que están lejos, oigan|Vosotros que estáis lejos, oíd}} lo que he hecho; \q {{plural_you:ustedes que están cerca, reconozcan|vosotros que estáis cerca, reconoced}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} fuerza.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escuchen, ustedes|Escuchad, vosotros}}, los que viven lejos. {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} lo que he hecho. \q {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}}, los que viven cerca, {{plural_you:vean|ved}} lo fuerte que soy.

fr.L: Écoutez, [vous qui êtes] loin, ce que j’ai fait ; \q et connaissez, [vous qui êtes] près, {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance.
fr.B: Vous qui êtes loin, écoutez ce que j’ai fait ; \q vous qui êtes près, reconnaissez {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} force.
fr.R: Écoutez, vous qui vivez loin d’ici. Écoutez ce que j’ai fait. \q Vous qui vivez tout près, voyez combien je suis fort.

sw.L: Sikieni, [enyi mlio] mbali, yale niliyoyafanya; \q na jueni, [enyi mlio] karibu, uweza {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: Ninyi mlio mbali, sikieni yale niliyoyafanya; \q ninyi mlio karibu, tambueni nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.
sw.R: Sikilizeni, enyi watu mnaoishi mbali. Sikieni yale niliyoyafanya. \q Enyi watu mnaoishi karibu, oneni jinsi nilivyo na nguvu.

decisions.choice: distant ones ... near ones: all people, from the farthest nations to the people close at hand
decisions.reason: The pair takes in everyone (57:19). The nations far off and the people in Zion are both to recognize what God has done to the destroyer.

decisions.choice: know: recognize and acknowledge
decisions.reason: Knowing here means accepting the truth of God's power once it is seen, not only learning a fact.

source.text: פָּחֲד֤וּ בְצִיּוֹן֙ חַטָּאִ֔ים אָחֲזָ֥ה רְעָדָ֖ה חֲנֵפִ֑ים מִ֣י׀יָג֣וּר לָ֗נוּ אֵ֚שׁ אוֹכֵלָ֔ה מִי־יָג֥וּר לָ֖נוּ מוֹקְדֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: They are in dread in Zion, sinners; trembling has seized the godless: who will sojourn for us [with] consuming fire? Who will sojourn for us [with] hearths of perpetuity?

en.L: [The] sinners in Zion are in dread; trembling has seized [the] godless: \q "Who among us can sojourn [with the] consuming fire? \q Who among us can sojourn [with] everlasting burnings?"
en.B: The sinners in Zion are terrified; the godless are gripped by trembling: \q "Which of us can live as a guest beside the devouring fire? \q Which of us can stay where the burning lasts forever?"
en.R: The sinners in Zion are afraid. People who reject God are shaking with fear. \q They ask, "Which of us can live near God, who is like a fire that destroys? \q Which of us can live near flames that never go out?"

es.L: [Los] pecadores en Sion tienen pavor; el temblor se ha apoderado de [los] impíos: \q «¿Quién de nosotros podrá morar [con el] fuego consumidor? \q ¿Quién de nosotros podrá morar [con las] llamas eternas?».
es.B: Los pecadores de Sion están aterrados; los impíos están presos del temblor: \q «¿Quién de nosotros podrá vivir como huésped junto al fuego devorador? \q ¿Quién de nosotros podrá quedarse donde el fuego arde para siempre?».
es.R: Los pecadores de Sion tienen miedo. Los que rechazan a Dios tiemblan de terror. \q Preguntan: «¿Quién de nosotros puede vivir cerca de Dios, que es como un fuego que destruye? \q ¿Quién de nosotros puede vivir cerca de llamas que nunca se apagan?».

fr.L: Les pécheurs sont effrayés en Sion ; le tremblement a saisi les impies : \q « Qui d’entre nous séjournera [auprès du] feu dévorant ? \q Qui d’entre nous séjournera [auprès des] brasiers éternels ? »
fr.B: Les pécheurs de Sion sont terrifiés ; un tremblement saisit les impies : \q « Qui de nous peut demeurer en hôte près du feu dévorant ? \q Qui de nous peut rester là où le feu brûle pour toujours ? »
fr.R: Les pécheurs de Sion ont peur. Ceux qui rejettent Dieu tremblent de peur. \q Ils demandent : « Qui de nous peut vivre près de Dieu, qui est comme un feu qui détruit ? \q Qui de nous peut vivre près de flammes qui ne s’éteignent jamais ? »

sw.L: Wenye dhambi katika Sayuni wanaogopa; kutetemeka kumewashika wasiomcha Mungu: \q "Ni nani kati yetu awezaye kukaa [na] moto ulao? \q Ni nani kati yetu awezaye kukaa [na] moto unaowaka milele?"
sw.B: Wenye dhambi katika Sayuni wameingiwa na hofu kuu; wasiomcha Mungu wameshikwa na kutetemeka: \q "Ni nani kati yetu awezaye kuishi kama mgeni karibu na moto unaoteketeza? \q Ni nani kati yetu awezaye kukaa mahali ambapo moto unawaka milele?"
sw.R: Wenye dhambi katika Sayuni wanaogopa. Watu wanaomkataa Mungu wanatetemeka kwa hofu. \q Wanauliza, "Ni nani kati yetu awezaye kuishi karibu na Mungu, aliye kama moto unaoangamiza? \q Ni nani kati yetu awezaye kuishi karibu na miali isiyozimika kamwe?"

decisions.choice: sojourn with the consuming fire: live in the presence of the holy God
alternatives: live through the fire of judgment on the enemy (verses 11-12)
decisions.reason: God is called a consuming fire (Deuteronomy 4:24; Isaiah 10:17; 30:27, 30). The question echoes Psalm 15:1 and 24:3, "Who may dwell on your holy hill?", and verses 15-16 give an answer like those psalms. To sojourn is to live as a guest under a host's protection.

decisions.choice: the godless: people who have turned from God
decisions.reason: The word describes those who are corrupt and faithless toward God, not only those who deny him (9:16; 10:6).

decisions.choice: near God, who is like a fire that destroys
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that the fire stands for God, following decision m1.

decisions.choice: live as a guest ... stay
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the verb's sense of living as a guest; Literal keeps "sojourn".

source.text: הֹלֵ֣ךְ צְדָק֔וֹת וְדֹבֵ֖ר מֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים מֹאֵ֞ס בְּבֶ֣צַע מַעֲשַׁקּ֗וֹת נֹעֵ֤ר כַּפָּיו֙ מִתְּמֹ֣ךְ בַּשֹּׁ֔חַד אֹטֵ֤ם אָזְנוֹ֙ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ דָּמִ֔ים וְעֹצֵ֥ם עֵינָ֖יו מֵרְא֥וֹת בְּרָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: One walking righteousnesses and speaking uprightnesses, rejecting gain of extortions, shaking his palms from holding on a bribe, shutting his ear from hearing bloods, and shutting his eyes from looking on evil,

en.L: [The] one walking [in] righteousness and speaking uprightly, \q rejecting [the] gain of extortion, shaking his hands from holding a bribe, \q stopping his ears from hearing [of] bloodshed, \q and shutting his eyes from looking on evil,
en.B: Whoever lives by what is right and speaks honestly, \q whoever turns down profit squeezed from others, whose hands shake off a bribe instead of grasping it, \q whose ears are closed to talk of bloodshed, \q and whose eyes are shut against gazing at evil,
en.R: The people who can live there are those who do what is right and speak the truth. \q They refuse to get rich by cheating others. They will not take bribes. \q They will not listen to plans to kill people. They will not look at evil things.

es.L: [El que] anda [en] justicia y habla con rectitud, \q [el que] desecha [la] ganancia de la extorsión, [el que] sacude sus manos para no tomar soborno, \q [el que] tapa sus oídos para no oír [de] derramamiento de sangre, \q y cierra sus ojos para no mirar el mal,
es.B: El que vive conforme a lo justo y habla con honradez, \q el que rechaza la ganancia sacada a la fuerza a otros, el que sacude las manos para no aceptar soborno, \q el que cierra los oídos a las conversaciones de sangre \q y cierra los ojos para no mirar el mal,
es.R: Los que pueden vivir allí son los que hacen lo que es justo y dicen la verdad. \q Se niegan a hacerse ricos engañando a otros. No aceptan sobornos. \q No escuchan planes para matar a nadie. No miran cosas malas.

fr.L: Celui qui marche [dans] la justice et parle avec droiture, \q qui rejette le gain de l’extorsion, qui secoue ses mains pour ne pas saisir de pot-de-vin, \q qui bouche ses oreilles pour ne pas entendre [parler] de sang, \q et ferme ses yeux pour ne pas regarder le mal,
fr.B: Celui qui vit selon la justice et parle avec franchise, \q qui refuse le profit arraché aux autres, dont les mains repoussent le pot-de-vin au lieu de le saisir, \q dont les oreilles se ferment aux projets de meurtre \q et dont les yeux refusent de contempler le mal,
fr.R: Ceux qui pourront vivre là sont ceux qui font ce qui est juste et disent la vérité. \q Ils refusent de s’enrichir en trompant les autres. Ils n’acceptent pas de pots-de-vin. \q Ils n’écoutent pas les projets de meurtre. Ils ne regardent pas les choses mauvaises.

sw.L: Yeye anayeenenda [katika] haki na kusema kwa unyofu, \q anayekataa faida ya dhuluma, anayeikung'uta mikono yake isishike rushwa, \q anayeziba masikio yake yasisikie [habari za] umwagaji damu, \q na kufumba macho yake yasitazame uovu,
sw.B: Yeyote anayeishi kwa kufuata yaliyo haki na kusema kwa uaminifu, \q yeyote anayekataa faida iliyobanwa kutoka kwa wengine, ambaye mikono yake hukung'uta rushwa badala ya kuishika, \q ambaye masikio yake yamefungwa yasisikie maneno ya kumwaga damu, \q na ambaye macho yake yamefumbwa yasitazame uovu,
sw.R: Watu wanaoweza kuishi huko ni wale wanaotenda yaliyo haki na kusema kweli. \q Wanakataa kutajirika kwa kuwadanganya wengine. Hawapokei rushwa. \q Hawasikilizi mipango ya kuua watu. Hawatazami mambo maovu.

decisions.choice: the one walking in righteousness: the answer to the question of verse 14
decisions.reason: Like Psalm 15:2-5 and 24:4, the answer describes a person whose life is honest and just. It gives six marks, in deed, word, money, hands, ears and eyes.

decisions.choice: hearing bloods: listening to plots to shed blood
decisions.reason: The plural "bloods" means bloodshed or guilt for killing. The person refuses even to listen when violence is planned (Proverbs 1:11-16).

decisions.choice: Whoever ... whose hands / They
decisions.reason: The description fits anyone, man or woman. Balanced uses "whoever" and "whose", and Readable the plural "they", in place of the masculine singular pronouns that Literal keeps.

decisions.choice: The people who can live there are
decisions.reason: Readable states the link to the question of verse 14.

source.text: ה֚וּא מְרוֹמִ֣ים יִשְׁכֹּ֔ן מְצָד֥וֹת סְלָעִ֖ים מִשְׂגַּבּ֑וֹ לַחְמ֣וֹ נִתָּ֔ן מֵימָ֖יו נֶאֱמָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: He on heights will dwell; strongholds of cliffs his refuge; his bread given, his water sure.

en.L: he will dwell [on the] heights; strongholds of rocks [will be] his refuge; \q his bread [will be] given, his water [will be] sure.
en.B: that one will make a home on the heights, with fortresses of rock for refuge, \q with bread supplied and water that never fails.
en.R: They will live in high places where they are safe. Rocky fortresses will protect them. \q They will always have food to eat and water to drink.

es.L: él morará [en las] alturas; fortalezas de peñas [serán] su refugio; \q su pan [le será] dado, su agua [será] segura.
es.B: ese vivirá en las alturas, con fortalezas de roca por refugio, \q con el pan asegurado y un agua que nunca falta.
es.R: Vivirán en lugares altos donde estarán seguros. Fortalezas de roca los protegerán. \q Siempre tendrán comida que comer y agua que beber.

fr.L: celui-là habitera [sur] les hauteurs ; des forteresses de rochers [seront] son refuge ; \q son pain [lui sera] donné, son eau [sera] assurée.
fr.B: celui-là habitera sur les hauteurs, avec des forteresses de roc pour refuge, \q avec du pain fourni et une eau qui ne manque jamais.
fr.R: Ils vivront en hauteur, là où ils seront en sécurité. Des forteresses de rochers les protégeront. \q Ils auront toujours de quoi manger et de l’eau à boire.

sw.L: yeye atakaa [mahali pa] juu; ngome za miamba [zitakuwa] kimbilio lake; \q mkate wake [atapewa], maji yake [ni] ya hakika.
sw.B: huyo atafanya makao yake juu milimani, ngome za miamba zikiwa kimbilio lake, \q akipewa mkate na maji yasiyokauka kamwe.
sw.R: Wataishi mahali pa juu ambapo wako salama. Ngome za miamba zitawalinda. \q Watakuwa na chakula cha kula na maji ya kunywa siku zote.

decisions.choice: heights ... strongholds of cliffs: a safe place God provides
decisions.reason: Fortresses on rocky heights could not easily be taken. The person who lives with God is kept safe and supplied, even in a siege, when bread and water ran short (36:12).

decisions.choice: sure: reliable, never running dry
decisions.reason: The word is used of what is faithful and lasting; the water supply will not fail (compare 58:11).

decisions.choice: that one
decisions.reason: Balanced continues verse 15's "whoever" with "that one" in place of "he" (see 15:r-en-1).

source.text: מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּיָפְי֖וֹ תֶּחֱזֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֑יךָ תִּרְאֶ֖ינָה אֶ֥רֶץ מַרְחַקִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: A king in his beauty your eyes will see; they will see a land of distances.

en.L: A king in his beauty your eyes will see; \q they will see a land of far distances.
en.B: Your eyes will see a king in his splendor; \q they will look on a land that stretches far away.
en.R: You will see the king in all his beauty. \q You will see a land that stretches out wide in every direction.

es.L: Al rey en su hermosura verán tus ojos; \q verán una tierra de lejanías.
es.B: Tus ojos verán a un rey en su esplendor; \q contemplarán una tierra que se extiende a lo lejos.
es.R: Verás al rey en toda su hermosura. \q Verás una tierra que se extiende amplia en todas direcciones.

fr.L: Un roi dans sa beauté, tes yeux le verront ; \q ils verront un pays aux lointains horizons.
fr.B: Tes yeux verront un roi dans sa splendeur ; \q ils contempleront un pays qui s’étend au loin.
fr.R: Tu verras le roi dans toute sa beauté. \q Tu verras un pays qui s’étend loin dans toutes les directions.

sw.L: Mfalme katika uzuri wake macho yako yataona; \q yataona nchi ya mbali.
sw.B: Macho yako yatamwona mfalme katika fahari yake; \q yataitazama nchi inayoenea mbali.
sw.R: Mtamwona mfalme katika uzuri wake wote. \q Mtaiona nchi inayoenea kwa upana pande zote.

decisions.choice: a king in his beauty: either the LORD himself as king, or the righteous king of David's line
alternatives: a human king of David's line
decisions.reason: Verse 22 calls the LORD "our king", and Zion's people will see him reigning. But 32:1 promises a king who will reign in righteousness, and the faithful king of David's line is described in beauty in Psalm 45:3. The text does not settle which is meant.

decisions.choice: a land of distances: a wide land with open borders
decisions.reason: Under siege the people saw only their walls. Now they will see a broad land stretching into the distance, no longer hemmed in.

decisions.choice: the king
decisions.reason: Readable uses "the" for a king the readers know is coming; the Hebrew has no article.

source.text: לִבְּךָ֖ יֶהְגֶּ֣ה אֵימָ֑ה אַיֵּ֤ה סֹפֵר֙ אַיֵּ֣ה שֹׁקֵ֔ל אַיֵּ֖ה סֹפֵ֥ר אֶת־הַמִּגְדָּלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Your heart will meditate on terror: where [is] the counter? where [is] the weigher? where [is] the counter of the towers?

en.L: Your heart will muse on [the] terror: \q "Where [is the] one who counted? Where [is the] one who weighed? \q Where [is the] one who counted the towers?"
en.B: Your mind will think back on the terror: \q "Where is the clerk who counted? Where is the one who weighed out the tribute? \q Where is the officer who counted the towers?"
en.R: You will remember how afraid you were. \q You will say, "Where are the enemy officials who counted our money? Where are those who weighed out what we paid? \q Where are the officers who counted our towers?"

es.L: Tu corazón meditará en el terror: \q «¿Dónde [está el] que contaba? ¿Dónde [está el] que pesaba? \q ¿Dónde [está el] que contaba las torres?».
es.B: Tu mente recordará el terror: \q «¿Dónde está el escribano que contaba? ¿Dónde está el que pesaba el tributo? \q ¿Dónde está el oficial que contaba las torres?».
es.R: Recordarás el miedo que tenías. \q Dirás: «¿Dónde están los funcionarios enemigos que contaban nuestro dinero? ¿Dónde están los que pesaban lo que pagábamos? \q ¿Dónde están los oficiales que contaban nuestras torres?».

fr.L: Ton cœur méditera sur la terreur : \q « Où [est] celui qui comptait ? Où [est] celui qui pesait ? \q Où [est] celui qui comptait les tours ? »
fr.B: Ton esprit repensera à la terreur : \q « Où est le scribe qui comptait ? Où est celui qui pesait le tribut ? \q Où est l’officier qui recensait les tours ? »
fr.R: Tu te souviendras combien tu avais peur. \q Tu diras : « Où sont les fonctionnaires ennemis qui comptaient notre argent ? Où sont ceux qui pesaient ce que nous payions ? \q Où sont les officiers qui comptaient nos tours ? »

sw.L: Moyo wako utatafakari juu ya hofu: \q "Yuko wapi yule aliyehesabu? Yuko wapi yule aliyepima? \q Yuko wapi yule aliyehesabu minara?"
sw.B: Akili yako itakumbuka hofu ile: \q "Yuko wapi karani aliyehesabu? Yuko wapi yule aliyepima kodi? \q Yuko wapi afisa aliyehesabu minara?"
sw.R: Mtakumbuka jinsi mlivyoogopa. \q Mtasema, "Wako wapi maafisa wa adui waliohesabu fedha zetu? Wako wapi wale waliopima tulichowalipa? \q Wako wapi maafisa waliohesabu minara yetu?"

decisions.choice: the one who counted ... weighed ... counted the towers: officials of the occupying enemy
decisions.reason: The "one who counted" is a scribe. Foreign officials recorded and weighed the tribute (2 Kings 18:14) and surveyed the city's towers to plan an attack or set taxes. Now they are gone. Paul echoes these questions in 1 Corinthians 1:20.

decisions.choice: the tribute / what we paid
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what was weighed: silver paid as tribute (2 Kings 18:14).

decisions.choice: the enemy officials
decisions.reason: Readable says who these people were, following decision m1.

source.text: אֶת־עַ֥ם נוֹעָ֖ז לֹ֣א תִרְאֶ֑ה עַ֣ם עִמְקֵ֤י שָׂפָה֙ מִשְּׁמ֔וֹעַ נִלְעַ֥ג לָשׁ֖וֹן אֵ֥ין בִּינָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: The people barbarous you will not see, a people deep of lip from hearing, stammering of tongue, no understanding.

en.L: The insolent people you will not see, \q a people of speech too deep to hear, of stammering tongue [that has] no understanding.
en.B: You will no longer see that fierce nation, \q a people whose speech is too strange to follow, whose stammering tongue makes no sense to you.
en.R: You will not see those cruel foreigners anymore. \q You will not hear their strange language that you could not understand.

es.L: Al pueblo insolente no verás, \q pueblo de habla demasiado profunda para oír, de lengua balbuceante [que] no se entiende.
es.B: Ya no verás a esa nación feroz, \q un pueblo de habla tan extraña que no se puede seguir, de lengua balbuceante que no tiene sentido para ti.
es.R: Ya no verás a esos extranjeros crueles. \q No oirás su idioma extraño que no podías entender.

fr.L: Le peuple arrogant, tu ne le verras plus, \q un peuple au langage trop profond pour être entendu, à la langue bégayante [qu’on ne peut] comprendre.
fr.B: Tu ne verras plus ce peuple féroce, \q ce peuple au parler trop étrange pour être suivi, dont la langue bégayante n’a aucun sens pour toi.
fr.R: Tu ne verras plus ces étrangers cruels. \q Tu n’entendras plus leur langue étrange, que tu ne pouvais pas comprendre.

sw.L: Watu wale wenye kiburi hutawaona, \q watu wa lugha ngumu mno kusikia, wa ulimi wa kigugumizi [usio na] maana.
sw.B: Hutaliona tena taifa lile kali, \q watu ambao maneno yao ni ya ajabu mno kufuatilia, ambao ulimi wao wa kigugumizi hauna maana kwako.
sw.R: Hamtawaona tena wageni wale wakatili. \q Hamtasikia lugha yao ya ajabu ambayo hamkuweza kuielewa.

decisions.choice: barbarous: fierce, insolent
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here. It is usually linked to a root meaning "be strong" or "be bold", describing a fierce and arrogant foe.

decisions.choice: deep of lip, stammering of tongue: a foreign language Judah could not understand
decisions.reason: God warned that he would speak to his people through foreigners with stammering lips and a strange tongue (28:11; Deuteronomy 28:49). The occupiers whose speech sounded like nonsense will be gone.

source.text: חֲזֵ֣ה צִיּ֔וֹן קִרְיַ֖ת מֽוֹעֲדֵ֑נוּ עֵינֶיךָ֩ תִרְאֶ֨ינָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם נָוֶ֣ה שַׁאֲנָ֗ן אֹ֤הֶל בַּל־יִצְעָן֙ בַּל־יִסַּ֤ע יְתֵֽדֹתָיו֙ לָנֶ֔צַח וְכָל־חֲבָלָ֖יו בַּל־יִנָּתֵֽקוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: See Zion, town of our appointed feast; your eyes will see Jerusalem, habitation undisturbed, a tent [that] not will be packed up; not will be pulled out its pegs forever, and all its ropes not will be torn apart.

en.L: See Zion, [the] city of our appointed feasts; \q your eyes will see Jerusalem, an untroubled dwelling, a tent [that] will not be packed up; its pegs will never be pulled out, \q and none of its ropes will be snapped.
en.B: Look at Zion, the city where we keep our festivals! \q Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a home at rest, a tent that will never be taken down. Its pegs will never be pulled up, \q and not one of its ropes will snap.
en.R: Look at Zion, the city where we gather to worship at the festivals! \q You will see Jerusalem as a calm and peaceful place to live. It will be like a tent that will never be moved. Its pegs will never be pulled up. \q Its ropes will never break.

es.L: Mira a Sion, [la] ciudad de nuestras fiestas señaladas; \q tus ojos verán a Jerusalén, morada tranquila, tienda [que] no será desmontada; sus estacas nunca serán arrancadas, \q y ninguna de sus cuerdas será rota.
es.B: ¡Mira a Sion, la ciudad donde celebramos nuestras fiestas! \q Tus ojos verán a Jerusalén, un hogar en reposo, una tienda que nunca será desmontada. Sus estacas nunca serán arrancadas, \q y ni una de sus cuerdas se romperá.
es.R: ¡Mira a Sion, la ciudad donde nos reunimos para adorar en las fiestas! \q Verás a Jerusalén como un lugar tranquilo y en paz para vivir. Será como una tienda que nunca se moverá. Sus estacas nunca serán arrancadas. \q Sus cuerdas nunca se romperán.

fr.L: Regarde Sion, la cité de nos fêtes fixées ; \q tes yeux verront Jérusalem, demeure tranquille, tente [qui] ne sera pas repliée ; ses piquets ne seront jamais arrachés, \q et aucun de ses cordages ne sera rompu.
fr.B: Regarde Sion, la ville où nous célébrons nos fêtes ! \q Tes yeux verront Jérusalem, une demeure en paix, une tente qu’on ne démontera jamais. Ses piquets ne seront jamais arrachés, \q et pas un de ses cordages ne cassera.
fr.R: Regarde Sion, la ville où nous nous réunissons pour adorer pendant les fêtes ! \q Tu verras que Jérusalem est un endroit calme et paisible où vivre. Elle sera comme une tente qu’on ne déplacera jamais. Ses piquets ne seront jamais arrachés. \q Ses cordes ne se casseront jamais.

sw.L: Tazama Sayuni, mji wa sikukuu zetu zilizoamriwa; \q macho yako yataona Yerusalemu, makao yasiyo na wasiwasi, hema [ambalo] halitang'olewa; vigingi vyake havitang'olewa milele, \q wala hakuna kamba yake itakayokatika.
sw.B: Itazame Sayuni, mji ambamo tunaadhimisha sikukuu zetu! \q Macho yako yataiona Yerusalemu, makao yenye utulivu, hema ambalo halitang'olewa kamwe. Vigingi vyake havitang'olewa kamwe, \q wala hakuna hata kamba yake moja itakayokatika.
sw.R: Itazame Sayuni, mji tunamokusanyika kuabudu wakati wa sikukuu! \q Mtaiona Yerusalemu kuwa mahali pa kuishi palipo tulivu na pa amani. Utakuwa kama hema lisilohamishwa kamwe. Vigingi vyake havitang'olewa kamwe. \q Kamba zake hazitakatika kamwe.

decisions.choice: town of our appointed feast: Jerusalem as the place of Israel's sacred festivals
decisions.reason: The word means an appointed time or gathering. The pilgrim festivals were kept at Jerusalem (Deuteronomy 16:16), and the city at peace will keep them again.

decisions.choice: a tent that will not be packed up: a home that will never again be uprooted
decisions.reason: The picture recalls the tent of meeting in the wilderness, which was taken down at every move. Jerusalem will be settled for good (54:2).

source.text: כִּ֣י אִם־שָׁ֞ם אַדִּ֤יר יְהוָה֙ לָ֔נוּ מְקוֹם־נְהָרִ֥ים יְאֹרִ֖ים רַחֲבֵ֣י יָדָ֑יִם בַּל־תֵּ֤לֶךְ בּוֹ֙ אֳנִי־שַׁ֔יִט וְצִ֥י אַדִּ֖יר לֹ֥א יַעַבְרֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: But there majestic Yahweh for us, a place of rivers, canals broad of both hands; not will go on it a ship of oar, and a ship majestic not will pass along it.

en.L: But there {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [will be] majestic for us, \q a place of rivers, of streams broad on both sides, \q where no galley with oars will go, \q and no majestic ship will pass.
en.B: Instead, there {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in majesty will be ours, \q a place of rivers and wide streams, \q where no galley with oars will sail \q and no mighty ship will pass through.
en.R: There {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will show us {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} greatness. \q He will be like wide rivers and streams around us. \q But no enemy warships will sail on them to attack us.

es.L: Pero allí {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [será] majestuoso para nosotros, \q lugar de ríos, de corrientes anchas por ambos lados, \q por donde no irá galera de remos, \q ni pasará nave majestuosa.
es.B: En cambio, allí tendremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en su majestad, \q un lugar de ríos y anchas corrientes, \q por donde no navegará galera de remos \q ni pasará ningún barco poderoso.
es.R: Allí {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos mostrará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} grandeza. \q Será como ríos y corrientes anchas a nuestro alrededor. \q Pero ningún barco de guerra enemigo navegará por ellos para atacarnos.

fr.L: Mais là {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [sera] majestueux pour nous, \q un lieu de fleuves, de canaux larges des deux côtés, \q où n’ira aucune galère à rames, \q et où ne passera aucun navire majestueux.
fr.B: Au contraire, là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera pour nous dans sa majesté \q un lieu de fleuves et de larges canaux, \q où ne voguera aucune galère à rames \q et où ne passera aucun puissant navire.
fr.R: Là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grandeur. \q Il sera comme de larges fleuves et des ruisseaux autour de nous. \q Mais aucun navire de guerre ennemi n’y naviguera pour nous attaquer.

sw.L: Lakini huko {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [atakuwa] mtukufu kwetu, \q mahali pa mito, pa vijito vipana pande zote mbili, \q ambapo hakuna mashua ya makasia itakayopita, \q wala merikebu tukufu haitapita.
sw.B: Badala yake, huko {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} atakuwa wetu, \q mahali pa mito na vijito vipana, \q ambapo hakuna mashua ya makasia itakayosafiri \q wala merikebu kubwa haitapita.
sw.R: Huko {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatuonyesha ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Atakuwa kama mito mipana na vijito vinavyotuzunguka. \q Lakini hakuna meli za vita za adui zitakazosafiri juu yake kutushambulia.

decisions.choice: a place of rivers: the LORD himself will be to Jerusalem what great rivers are to other cities
decisions.reason: Jerusalem had no river. Cities like Thebes and Nineveh were guarded by water (Nahum 3:8), and the LORD will be that protection. Compare the river that gladdens the city of God (Psalm 46:5).

decisions.choice: a ship of oar ... a majestic ship: warships
decisions.reason: A river can bring enemy fleets, but these rivers will carry no war galleys. The same word "majestic" is used for the LORD and for the ship: the only majesty in that place is God's.

decisions.choice: enemy warships ... to attack us
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of ships are meant, following decision m2.

source.text: כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֔נוּ יְהוָ֖ה מְחֹקְקֵ֑נוּ יְהוָ֥ה מַלְכֵּ֖נוּ ה֥וּא יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For Yahweh [is] our judge; Yahweh [is] our commander; Yahweh [is] our king; he will deliver us.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] our judge, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] our lawgiver, \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] our king; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will save us.
en.B: For our judge is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, our lawgiver is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q our king is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} will save us.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the one who judges us. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gives us our laws. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is our king. He will save us.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] nuestro juez, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] nuestro legislador, \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] nuestro rey; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos salvará.
es.B: Porque nuestro juez es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, nuestro legislador es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q nuestro rey es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo nos salvará.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es quien nos juzga. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos da nuestras leyes. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es nuestro rey. Él nos salvará.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] notre juge, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] notre législateur, \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] notre roi ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous sauvera.
fr.B: Car notre juge, c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; notre législateur, c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q notre roi, c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui nous sauvera.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est celui qui nous juge. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous donne nos lois. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est notre roi. Il nous sauvera.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwamuzi wetu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mtoa sheria wetu, \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mfalme wetu; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atatuokoa.
sw.B: Kwa maana mwamuzi wetu ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mtoa sheria wetu ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mfalme wetu ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} atatuokoa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye anayetuhukumu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye anayetupa sheria zetu. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mfalme wetu. Yeye atatuokoa.

decisions.choice: lawgiver: the one who decrees and rules
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to inscribe or decree. It can mean the one who gives laws, or a ruler or commander (Genesis 49:10; Judges 5:14). Here, beside "judge" and "king", it names the LORD as the one who governs his people.

decisions.choice: Yahweh ... Yahweh ... Yahweh ... he: the LORD alone rules and rescues
decisions.reason: Judging, making law and ruling as king were the duties of a king in Israel. All three belong to the LORD, and the emphatic "he" stresses that he and no one else will save.

decisions.choice: our judge is the LORD
decisions.reason: Balanced puts each title first so the divine name ends each line with weight, and renders the emphatic pronoun "he himself".

source.text: נִטְּשׁ֖וּ חֲבָלָ֑יִךְ בַּל־יְחַזְּק֤וּ כֵן־תָּרְנָם֙ בַּל־פָּ֣רְשׂוּ נֵ֔ס אָ֣ז חֻלַּ֤ק עַֽד־שָׁלָל֙ מַרְבֶּ֔ה פִּסְחִ֖ים בָּ֥זְזוּ בַֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: They hang loose, your ropes; not they make firm the base of their mast, not they spread out a sail; then will be divided booty of plunder in abundance; lame ones will take spoil.

en.L: Your ropes hang loose; \q they do not hold the base of their mast firm; they do not spread [the] sail. \q Then booty of plunder will be divided in abundance; \q [the] lame will take [the] spoil.
en.B: Your ropes hang slack; \q they cannot hold the mast firm in its socket or spread out the sail. \q Then plunder will be shared out in heaps, \q and even the lame will carry off spoil.
en.R: Enemy, you are like a ship whose ropes are loose. \q The ropes cannot hold up the mast. The sail cannot be raised. \q Then all your treasure will be divided up. \q There will be so much that even people who cannot walk well will carry some away.

es.L: Tus cuerdas cuelgan flojas; \q no sujetan firme la base de su mástil, no despliegan [la] vela. \q Entonces se repartirá botín de despojos en abundancia; \q [los] cojos tomarán [el] despojo.
es.B: Tus cuerdas cuelgan sueltas; \q no pueden sostener el mástil en su encaje ni desplegar la vela. \q Entonces se repartirán despojos a montones, \q y hasta los cojos se llevarán botín.
es.R: Enemigo, eres como un barco con las cuerdas flojas. \q Las cuerdas no pueden sostener el mástil. La vela no se puede izar. \q Entonces todos tus tesoros serán repartidos. \q Habrá tanto que hasta los que no pueden caminar bien se llevarán algo.

fr.L: Tes cordages sont relâchés ; \q ils ne tiennent pas ferme le pied de leur mât, ils ne déploient pas la voile. \q Alors on partagera le butin d’un pillage abondant ; \q les boiteux prendront leur part du butin.
fr.B: Tes cordages pendent, détendus ; \q ils ne peuvent tenir le mât dans son emboîture ni déployer la voile. \q Alors on partagera le butin par monceaux, \q et même les boiteux emporteront des dépouilles.
fr.R: Ennemi, tu es comme un bateau dont les cordes sont lâches. \q Les cordes ne peuvent pas tenir le mât. On ne peut pas hisser la voile. \q Alors tous tes trésors seront partagés. \q Il y en aura tant que même ceux qui marchent mal en emporteront.

sw.L: Kamba zako zimelegea; \q haziwezi kushikilia imara kitako cha mlingoti wao; hawawezi kutandika tanga. \q Ndipo mateka ya nyara yatagawanywa kwa wingi; \q viwete watachukua nyara.
sw.B: Kamba zako zimelegea; \q haziwezi kuushika mlingoti imara mahali pake wala kutandaza tanga. \q Ndipo nyara zitagawanywa kwa marundo, \q na hata viwete watachukua nyara.
sw.R: Enyi adui, mko kama meli ambayo kamba zake zimelegea. \q Kamba hizo haziwezi kuushikilia mlingoti. Tanga haliwezi kupandishwa. \q Ndipo hazina zenu zote zitagawanywa. \q Zitakuwa nyingi kiasi kwamba hata watu wasioweza kutembea vizuri watachukua sehemu yake.

decisions.choice: your ropes hang loose: the enemy pictured as a ship that cannot sail
decisions.reason: "Your" is singular and returns to the destroyer of verse 1. Following the rivers and warships of verse 21, the enemy is a ship falling apart. Some read it as Zion, weak now but about to share in the plunder.

decisions.choice: booty ... lame: the spoil is so great that even the weakest take a share
decisions.reason: The rare word for booty also occurs in Genesis 49:27. Normally the strong took the spoil; here even the lame do, because God won the victory, not Judah's soldiers.

decisions.choice: Enemy, you are like a ship
decisions.reason: Readable names the one addressed and states the comparison, following decision m1.

source.text: וּבַל־יֹאמַ֥ר שָׁכֵ֖ן חָלִ֑יתִי הָעָ֛ם הַיֹּשֵׁ֥ב בָּ֖הּ נְשֻׂ֥א עָוֺֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And not will say an inhabitant, I am sick; the people dwelling in it forgiven of iniquity.

en.L: And no inhabitant will say, "I am sick"; \q the people who dwell in it [will be] forgiven [their] iniquity.
en.B: No one who lives there will say, "I am sick"; \q the people who dwell in it will have their guilt forgiven.
en.R: No one who lives in Zion will say, "I am sick." \q God will forgive the sins of the people who live there.

es.L: Y ningún habitante dirá: «Estoy enfermo»; \q al pueblo que habita en ella [le será] perdonada [su] iniquidad.
es.B: Nadie que viva allí dirá: «Estoy enfermo»; \q al pueblo que habita en ella se le perdonará su culpa.
es.R: Nadie que viva en Sion dirá: «Estoy enfermo». \q Dios perdonará los pecados de la gente que vive allí.

fr.L: Et aucun habitant ne dira : « Je suis malade » ; \q le peuple qui y habite [aura reçu le] pardon de [son] iniquité.
fr.B: Aucun de ses habitants ne dira : « Je suis malade » ; \q le peuple qui y demeure verra sa faute pardonnée.
fr.R: Personne qui habite à Sion ne dira : « Je suis malade. » \q Dieu pardonnera les péchés des gens qui y vivent.

sw.L: Wala hakuna mkaaji atakayesema, "Mimi ni mgonjwa"; \q watu wanaokaa ndani yake [watasamehewa] uovu [wao].
sw.B: Hakuna anayeishi huko atakayesema, "Mimi ni mgonjwa"; \q watu wanaokaa ndani yake watasamehewa hatia yao.
sw.R: Hakuna anayeishi katika Sayuni atakayesema, "Mimi ni mgonjwa." \q Mungu atawasamehe dhambi watu wanaoishi huko.

decisions.choice: I am sick ... forgiven of iniquity: healing and forgiveness come together
decisions.reason: Sickness was a picture of the nation's sin and its results (1:5-6). The promise ends with God taking away guilt, the deepest need behind the city's suffering (40:2; 53:5).

decisions.choice: forgiven of iniquity: their iniquity is lifted away
decisions.reason: The verb means "lifted" or "carried": their guilt is removed. The passive leaves God as the one who forgives.

decisions.choice: God will forgive
decisions.reason: Readable names the one who forgives, which the passive verb implies.
